scientific_integrity: General theorem proved constructively using the exact edge-chromatic index of doubled cliques. Finite independent computational tests corroborate but do not replace the proof. No external certification claimed.
scientific_limitations: Counts uncolored supports, not all colored labelings; assumes singleton labels, the full degree-sized palette and complete rectangular rook graphs. Bibliographic priority remains subject to unindexed equivalents.
title: Full-palette singleton rainbow domination on rectangular rook graphs
